instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use the specific fonts: Cormorant Garamond for headings, Outfit for body text.
Do NOT use pure white or pure black. Use the provided colors.
Create a sticky floating WhatsApp button on the bottom right across all pages.
Use framer-motion for smooth fade-ins and scroll-based reveals.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, forms) as per guidelines.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor Icons for elegant minimalist icons.
The Hero overlay should not be darker than bg-black/40. Let the garden image show through.
Ensure generous padding around sections (e.g., py-24).
